title: "It answers questions that I didn't know I had": Ph.D. Students’ Evaluation of an Information-Sharing Knowledge Graph
reasoning: The paper focuses on the usability evaluation of a knowledge graph for Ph.D. students. Although it mentions being inspired by a Hawaiian epistemological approach as a framework for its design and briefly discusses data privacy, it does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary focus or component of its research.
